issues: The verse identifies these as Zeniff’s spies, but does not explicitly identify them as Nephite.
The north of Shilom is stated for the Lamanite advance in the preceding verse, not explicitly for this battle scene.
The battle’s location north of Shilom is inferred from the preceding account; verse 19 does not specify it.
“Their land” is stated, but identifying it specifically as the land of Shilom relies on prior context.
The character label “Nephite settlers (2 Nephi)” assigns the people to an unrelated, unestablished group; the verse identifies them only as Zeniff’s people.
